title: The Muslim World Must Have One Head
body:
When we are going to say something important for this world, it is sunnah to stand up and say, (Mawlana
Shaykh stands) “Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'lhamd! Allahuma salli `alaa Sayyidina Muhammad. Yaa Rabbana, yaa Rabb ighfir w ’arham wa Anta khayru 'rRaahimeen … wa `alaykum as-salaam wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) And we are
saying, “A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.” Huuuu.
O Our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum. Madad, yaa RijaalAllah. This meeting is something we have been
granted to give all Mankind. One is enough for all nations; one may save the whole world, yes. Therefore, we
are in a holy meeting and it is a declaration for all Mankind. Madad, yaa RijaalAllah!
Now on Earth, there are two poles: at one pole lies a flag of the heavenly ones from Heaven, and at the other
pole is a flag from Shaytan and its followers. The Seal of Prophets (s) warned people that when the Last Day
approaches they are going to be under two flags at different poles. One, the flag that belongs to the Seal of
Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) is a heavenly, holy and honored flag
fixed on Earth from the Heavens. The second is another flag, not from the Heavens, but it is from Earth, and
there are some signs of it that are not heavenly. One is fixed in Oriental (Eastern) countries, where the sun
rises and shines; the second is fixed in Western countries where the sun sets.

Whoever is going toward the Oriental direction is going to see, meet and feel everything that belongs to
heavenly aspects there. SubhaanAllah! Western people always have such a deep desire to run to Oriental
countries because their spirituality is attracted there, and foolish people from Eastern countries who follow
their physical enjoyment are attracted to Western countries! Western people are asking something for their
spirituality and foolish Eastern people are asking to reach more pleasure for their egos and material beings.
Therefore, at the end of the world you will find Western people will run to this sun-shining, sun-rising
horizon in the east since they have such a deep attraction to be there.
As Prophet (s) said, as the Last Day approaches, people will be of two parties: one party's souls are attracted
to heavenly aspects, and they will never get satisfaction from Western holy places, but they will seek holy
places where they will be happy. Now, foolish people in Oriental countries are running after their egos and
seeking much more pleasure from Western countries that give them many more opportunities to indulge
their egoistic desires. SubhaanAllah! Western people are much more attracted to come to Islam, to Oriental
countries. Prophet (s) is warning his nation, "O People, you are reaching a time when people will be in two
parties; one asking for spirituality and one is asking for material aspects, and there will be a great war
between the two people."
Now the Muslim world's people are running after the Western world's aspects, leaving the most high honors
of Islam to be like Western people. I am asking forgiveness for me and for the whole Muslim nation. They are
going to be fed up with Islam and will run to contentment by being with Western people. Right now you are
looking at what is happening, and the Prophet (s) was saying, "O my nation! You will be so eager to be like
Western people: you will step on their steps and will do everything they do, even if they fall in the hole of a
fox you will also fall in it!"
Now the whole Muslim world is so ignorant, filled with no-mind, non-thinking people asking to be like those
in Western countries! Now fire is burning throughout the Muslim world, beginning with Egypt, then Libya,
Tunis, Yemen, Syria, Lebanon, Iran and the Turks, whose Muslim citizens are asking to step on the steps of
Western countries! Now they are in a very different, difficult position and everywhere there are so many
crises and troubles. Everywhere people are saying, "We must change our governments," and they are fed up
with their tyrant leaders because they have been cheated. Now, some countries like Egypt, Libya, Turkey and

others are asking for a new system, to be able to choose (elect) someone and bring them in. That is not
Shari`atullah, which is ordering from the Heavens!
O Muslim world! You must have one person as leader! I am saying to those foolish leaders from the Islamic
countries, it is possible for this to be! They are saying the Muslim world is so weak, how is one person going
to be over their heads, ruling them? I am saying, "As the holy command is coming (supporting that)!" Now
the whole Muslim world is afraid of China, which is one nation and with only one person leading and
governing: two billion people are under the command of that one person!
O Muslim Leaders and Muslim `Ulama! Why are you not thinking to say that the Muslim world must have
one khalifah, one sultan? If you don’t ask for this, I will ask that a curse falls on you from the Heavens! You
are asking for Egypt to be a republic with a president, that each country must have a president, that you don't
like to have the whole Muslim world under one person. No! You are saying in the Islamic world you (Libya)
are going to be the leader, and then they killed their leader (Muammar Ghaddafi)! They claim to be
democratic countries by voting in an election, but they are on the wrong way because they are not claiming
what Allah Almighty said, that you must have one head. He is never accepting that you should have two
heads! The whole Islamic world must have one head and it must be under Shari`atullah. Look at China, with
two billion people under one head.
I am sorry to say that all nations of the Islamic world will be cursed like never before! Now Libya is saying
that its tyrant has passed away and it must have an election. In Syria, in Shaam they are saying they must
have an election. No, for the whole Islamic world there must be one head! People fear the Chinese, who have
two billion people under one person's command! We need one person who is supported by the Heavens. If
not, all will be taken away and from forty there will not be one left; they will be taken away. That is a heavenly
warning for the whole Muslim world. If they are understanding, they will be in safety; if not, their heads will
be like the tyrant of Libya and worse. Therefore, it is a heavenly warning.
O People! Come and stand under the holy flag of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana
Shaykh stands and sits) Those who are accepting will be saved and those refusing will be taken away. It is not
from me, but is the Holy Prophet's (s) declaration about what is coming. If you are accepting, you will be
saved, but if you are not accepting, there will be three months and then they will be taken away also.

O People! I am not addressing a handful of people, but this is addressing from the Heavens from east to west,
from west to east. Even the Western countries can't be saved by the way they are governing people; they must
change, they must go from democracy or they will go down, down, down. May Allah (swt) forgive us.
O People! Try to understand what has been sent to you. If they are taking care and bring a khalifah, they will
be saved; if not, first the leaders will be judged, then hundreds of thousands and even millions of people will
be taken away.
O People! Keep the honor of Islam and the governing bodies of Shari`atullah. If not, you will be taken away.
May Allah forgive us for the honor of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh
stands and sits)
Fatihah.
(Baya`)
Hasbun Allahu wa ni`ma ‘l-wakeel. Laa hawla wa laa quwwata illa billahi ‘l-`Aliyyu ‘l-`Azheem! Radeena
billahi Rabban wa bi ‘l-Islaami deenan wa bi Sayyidina Muhammadan sallAllahu `alayhi wa sallama Nabiyya
wa Rasoola wa amantu bi shari`atullah that is coming from Heavens to the Seal of Prophets (s), and we are
following and asking to follow the Seal of Prophet's (s) governing ways of Islam, and we are not asking to
have shaytanic governments on Earth. We will be supported by heavenly powers if we are going on that way;
if not, Shaytan will take all people on Earth to the Hellfire! May Allah forgive us and protect you.
Bi jaahi man anzalta `alayhi Suratu ’l-Fatihah.
